name: Inditex

sources.title: Inditex Group Annual Report 2025 - Consolidated Annual Accounts, Note 11 Segment reporting (FY2025 and FY2024)
Inditex Group Annual Report 2024 - Consolidated Annual Accounts, segment reporting note (FY2024 and FY2023)
Inditex FY2025 Results (1 Feb 2025 - 31 Jan 2026), sales and PBT by concept
Inditex FY2024 Results (1 Feb 2024 - 31 Jan 2025), PBT by concept 2024/2023

notes: Revenue = net sales ('sales to third parties'); segment profit measure = profit before taxes, the only segment profit Inditex publishes (EBIT is not published by segment or concept; group EBIT was 7,997 in FY2025 and 7,554 in FY2024). FY2025 and FY2024 from the 2025 consolidated accounts; FY2023 from the 2024 consolidated accounts. FY2024 figures are identical in both reports (no restatement); the first segment was labelled 'Zara / Zara Home' in the 2024 accounts and 'Zara / Zara Home / Lefties' in the 2025 accounts with unchanged figures (Lefties historically reported within Zara). FY2025 PBT: segments + inter-segment sum to 8,019 vs published total 8,020 (rounding, inter-segment shown as '-'). 'Other' brands: the accounts say Other groups the retail concepts other than Zara, Zara Home, Lefties and Bershka; the concepts listed in Note 1 are Zara, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho, Lefties and Zara Home. Finer split from the results press releases (sales / PBT, EUR m): FY2025 Zara (incl. Zara Home & Lefties) 28,051 / 5,601; Pull&Bear 2,546 / 422; Massimo Dutti 2,019 / 434; Bershka 3,286 / 657; Stradivarius 3,002 / 707; Oysho 960 / 198. FY2024: Zara 27,778 / 5,407; Pull&Bear 2,469 / 458; Massimo Dutti 1,960 / 402; Bershka 2,930 / 548; Stradivarius 2,664 / 616; Oysho 831 / 146. FY2023 PBT by concept: Zara 5,004; Pull&Bear 438; Massimo Dutti 339; Bershka 460; Stradivarius 493; Oysho 136 (FY2023 sales by concept not retrieved). Concept figures are net of intra-group sales and differ slightly from the IFRS 8 segment figures.
